quirks.description: Directus stores files by UUID on disk. Multiple files can share the same original name but have different UUIDs.
quirks.workaround: Use the UUID from the URL as filename base, not alt text or original filename.

quirks.description: Directus asset URLs: /assets/<uuid> or /assets/<uuid>/<seo-filename.ext>. Transform params: width, height, fit (cover/contain/inside/outside), format (auto/jpg/png/webp/avif), quality (1-100). Preset mode: ?key=<preset-name>.
quirks.workaround: Strip query params for download. Use responsiveFormat for optimized sizes. If ?key= fails, site may be in presets-only mode.

quirks.description: Optional SEO filename after UUID: /assets/<uuid>/<filename.ext>. The UUID is NOT always the last path segment.
quirks.workaround: Extract UUID from the path segment after /assets/, ignoring any following filename segment.

quirks.description: Directus is headless. X-Powered-By: Directus only appears on the API server, never the frontend. Detection relies on UUID-patterned /assets/ paths in rendered HTML. If frontend proxies assets, Directus is invisible.
quirks.workaround: Fundamental limitation. If no /assets/<uuid> patterns found, Directus cannot be auto-detected.

quirks.description: ASSETS_TRANSFORM config has 3 modes: 'all' (default, any params), 'presets' (only ?key= works), 'none' (no transforms). responsiveFormat may fail on presets-only sites.
quirks.workaround: If width/height params return errors, try ?key= with common preset names. Document preset names in research file.
